source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 习近平对西藏泥石流灾害作出重要指示
topics.official_english: Xi Jinping issues important instructions on Tibet mudslide disaster
topics.why_hot: A major mudslide in Tibet triggered a top-level response and became the leading national news item.
topics.share_angle: Explain the disaster background, the government’s response, and why Tibet’s mountainous terrain is prone to mudslides.

topics.chinese_topic: 直击西藏泥石流最新情况
topics.official_english: On the ground: latest situation of Tibet mudslide
topics.why_hot: People are following live updates and rescue information from the affected area.
topics.share_angle: Use the latest reports to give a timeline of the disaster and show how local authorities and residents are responding.

topics.why_hot: A large-scale investment package is seen as a key economic signal and is being widely discussed.
topics.share_angle: Explain what the 4 trillion yuan is reportedly for and how it might affect growth, jobs, and infrastructure.

topics.why_hot: A robot breaking a 100-meter record captures public imagination about how fast machines are getting.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the reported record and place it in the context of robotics development, without overclaiming speed.

topics.chinese_topic: 上海13岁女孩靠AI 3天赚了1.8万元
topics.official_english: 13-year-old Shanghai girl earns 18,000 yuan in 3 days using AI
topics.why_hot: The story mixes AI, childhood education, and income, sparking both admiration and debate.
topics.share_angle: Use it to discuss AI literacy for young people, online safety, and how schools and parents are responding to AI tools.

topics.chinese_topic: 网传“8月新冠有变异毒株”不实
topics.official_english: Rumor of a new COVID-19 variant in August is false
topics.why_hot: COVID-related rumors spread quickly, so the denial itself became a trending topic.
topics.share_angle: Explain why this rumor is false, how official channels verify variant claims, and what readers should rely on.

topics.chinese_topic: 癌症疫苗预计近50万美元1针
topics.official_english: Cancer vaccine expected to cost nearly $500,000 per shot
topics.why_hot: A potential cancer vaccine with a huge price tag raises urgent questions about access, affordability, and healthcare equity.
topics.share_angle: Compare the science behind cancer vaccines with the real-world challenge of making them affordable.

topics.chinese_topic: 上海体育局回应刘翔退役安置工作
topics.official_english: Shanghai sports authorities respond to Liu Xiang's post-retirement arrangements
topics.why_hot: Liu Xiang is a beloved sports icon, and news about his retirement benefits sparks discussion on how athletes are supported after competition.
topics.share_angle: Talk about Liu Xiang's legacy and the broader system of post-retirement support for Chinese athletes.
